ns2:course.label: Introduction to Piano Literature II
ns2:course.description: Provides an overview of the piano repertoire, with representative works from late 19th century to the present. The content of the course will include assigned readings, listening, and in-class lecture/discussions of musical and technical challenges of the works discussed. Prerequisite: MUS 317; or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: MUS 317; or consent of instructor.
